classification_basis: B6N8C Track A is a design recommendation only. This audit recovers a force/thermal/rheology-dependent model with evolved physical state and does not authorize implementation or parameter selection.
blocking_reason: Primary equation forms requested for B6N8-D were visually recovered from the supplied PDF page images. numerical column/cross-section discretization, thermal and thickness boundary conditions, stability/error assessment, and validity/model-form limitations

mechanics_classification.evidence_based_refinement: TIER_2_PLUS_LIMITED_MECHANICAL_STATE (reduced thin-sheet force balance and constitutive strength, not full regional continuum mechanics)
mechanics_classification.reason: It requires yielding, power-law ductile stress, integrated lithospheric resistance, buoyancy forces and pressure-driven crustal flow. Calling it mechanics-free or a pure Tier-2 phenomenological state model would be inaccurate. Buck does not require a full finite-element/Stokes solve.
